subject: general
question: At which place has India established CIRUS reactor?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Trombay, Mumbai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The CIRUS reactor was commissioned at the Bhabha Atomic Research Centre (BARC) in Trombay, Mumbai.
 
• It was a 40 MW research reactor used for the production of plutonium.
 
• The reactor was supplied by Canada and was heavy water moderated but used natural uranium fuel.
 
• CIRUS stands for "Canada-India Reactor, U.S." because the heavy water was supplied by the United States.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bhabha Atomic Research Centre (BARC)**

 
 
• BARC is India's premier nuclear research facility headquartered in Trombay, Mumbai.
 
• It was established in 1954 by Dr. Homi Jehangir Bhabha.
 
• BARC is involved in advanced research and development covering the entire spectrum of nuclear science, engineering, and related areas.
 
 
 
• **Plutonium Production**
 
 
• Plutonium is a key element used in nuclear reactors and nuclear weapons.
 
• It is produced in reactors by irradiating uranium-238 with neutrons.
 
• The CIRUS reactor was one of the main sources of plutonium for India's nuclear weapons program.
 
 
 
• **Heavy Water**
 
 
• Heavy water (D2O) is used as a neutron moderator in certain types of nuclear reactors.
 
• It slows down neutrons, making them more likely to induce fission in uranium-235 or plutonium-239.
 
• Heavy water reactors can use natural uranium as fuel, which is an advantage in countries with limited access to enriched uranium.
 
 
 
• **Natural Uranium**
 
 
• Natural uranium consists mostly of uranium-238 with about 0.7% uranium-235.
 
• It can be used as fuel in reactors with heavy water or graphite moderators.
 
• Natural uranium reactors do not require enrichment facilities, which simplifies the fuel supply chain.
